items.text:
Let it be — no voice.

Edward, born 90 seconds ago, walked north, north, north, then east out of the Deep Passage and is standing at the foot of The Sunken Stair: the first person ever to reach the room. Two things answered themselves in his first fourteen events — a living monster does **not** block movement (he passed the troll and goblin rooms without fighting), and the stair is reachable by a fresh life, so the remap contingency in my last entry is not needed. His only unparsed command, "Back," he fixed himself in three seconds with "South."

He is mid-discovery of the thing I built for exactly this. He has asked nothing. Anything from me now lands on him before he has even looked at the wall.
